thesis:
This run focused on leveraging the Quality Matrix's top picks, emphasizing strong composite scores and exceptional drilling results. We successfully opened long positions on two top picks:

1. **GR Silver Mining Ltd. (GRSL.V)**: Strong Silver Grade (308 g/t Ag) with a PAAS anchor; Moderate Drill Program Type (Exploration vs Resource).
2. **Marimaca Copper (MC2.AX)**: Strong Copper Grade (2.2% over 424m) with an NGEx Lunahuasi anchor; Moderate Drill Program Type (Exploration vs Resource).

The strategy was to capitalize on high-quality drilling results, which are crucial for long-term value in the mining sector. No shorts were opened this run due to the absence of concrete bearish headlines paired with Red-Flag signals.
